held.title: Agent badge comes from the earliest remaining comment, but the owner shown comes from the thread author.
held.body: `getThreadAgent` picks the agent from whichever comment has the earliest `createdAt`. `TlaThreadRow` and `TlaPinContent` then show that agent next to `props.author` / `thread.createdBy`. If the thread's opening comment is missing from `comments` (deleted or filtered out) and the earliest remaining one is an agent reply posted for someone else, the row and the pin read "Claude / Alice" with Alice's avatar badged, even though Alice never used an agent. I couldn't check whether a thread's first comment can be removed while its replies stay. Fix: only return the agent when that first comment's author matches `thread.createdBy`, or read it from the thread's root comment directly.
